environment.backend: each application's real backend at its RC0 commit, with a fresh temporary workspace seeded by the application's own setup action

evidence_class: OBSERVED_RUNTIME for the rows it lists, in one browser only.
limits: Chromium only. Firefox and WebKit were not available.
Only surfaces with their own address were visited. Dialogs, drawers, tabs held in memory and anything behind a click were not opened.
Pages were loaded, not operated: no form was submitted and no write was attempted.
An axe scan finds a subset of accessibility failures. It is not a keyboard or screen-reader review.
Data was whatever a fresh workspace holds, so empty and loaded states are mixed.
